source_attribution: European Space Agency (ESA) Sentinel-2 MSI via Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem (CDSE)
scientific_notes: Scientific Attribution: Visual indicators are experimental relative proxies derived from 8-bit RGB preview imagery (Green-to-Red and Red-to-Cyan ratios). They provide qualitative spatial plume delineation and do NOT represent standard Sentinel-2 NDCI (which requires calibrated native Band 5 Red Edge at 705 nm and Band 4 Red at 665 nm) or quantitative physical SPM concentration.
scientific_disclaimer: Scientific Notice: Preview-derived indicators are experimental visual proxies for qualitative anomaly detection only. Because 8-bit JPEG previews undergo non-linear sRGB gamma-stretching and lossy compression, they DO NOT preserve quantitative physical surface reflectance values. These proxies MUST NOT be asserted as native-band scientific measurements, chemical pollutant concentrations, or toxic algal species identifications without in-situ corroboration.
